title: 5 - Music Row Modern - The Music City Collection
description:
LOCATION At this centrally located gem, attractions like the Johnny Cash Museum, the Country Music Hall of Fame, and the Ryman Auditorium are all just about a mile away, and in-between is your pick of cafes, craft breweries, local bars and music venues.  Enjoy the views from the expansive private rooftop.  The terrace has plenty of room to hang out and enjoy the Nashville Skies with a cozy fireplace.  

STR Permit #2022072625

The space
There is a two car garage and driveway with free street parking surrounding the house.  The first level of the home consists of the two car garage and two king Bedrooms that share a jack and jill bath.  The second level boasts an open floor plan living area, dining room, kitchen, half bath,  and third bedroom with king bed and full ensuite bath. The primary bedroom suite with king bed and large bath is located on the third level with  the bonus room, another half bath,  and the rooftop terrace!  The terrace has plenty of room to hang out and enjoy the Nashville Skies with a cozy fireplace.  There are sleeper sofas in the living area and bonus room for additional guests. 

Our team is available by text throughout your stay.

Guest access
Guests have access to the entire house, private rooftop, and attached two car garage.
